risks.reasoning: For the six months ended June 30, 2022, the audited cash flow statement reports net cash flows used in operating activities of RMB74,558 thousand and cash and cash equivalents at period end of RMB114,965 thousand. Monthly operating cash burn is approximately RMB12,426 thousand and cash runway is approximately 9.25 months, below the 12-month trigger and at or above the 6-month high threshold.

The accountants' report shows profit for the year/period of RMB59,398 thousand, RMB203,182 thousand, RMB338,771 thousand, RMB174,258 thousand and RMB62,781 thousand for 2019, 2020, 2021, H1 2021 and H1 2022 respectively. There are zero comparable loss periods.
Revenue decreased from RMB1,831,718 thousand in H1 2021 to RMB1,262,394 thousand in H1 2022, a decline of approximately 31.08%. The decline is at or below the frozen -20% high threshold.

For H1 2022, the largest customer accounted for approximately 13.8% and the top five customers accounted for approximately 35.3% of revenue. Both ratios remain below the frozen medium thresholds of 30% and 60%.

For H1 2022, the largest supplier accounted for approximately 12.7% and the five largest suppliers accounted for approximately 29.6% of total purchases. Both ratios remain below the frozen medium thresholds of 30% and 60%.

The Pre-IPO Investors were granted special rights under the Series A and Series B investment agreements. Supplemental agreements provide that the special rights lapse or are terminated upon submission of the listing application documents to the CSRC, and the Joint Sponsors confirmed that all special rights have been terminated or will cease to be effective prior to the Listing. No restoration is disclosed.

The formal Legal Proceedings and Compliance section states that the Group had not been and was not a party to any material legal, arbitral or administrative proceedings and was not aware of any pending or threatened proceedings with a material adverse effect. The disclosed advertising and social-insurance compliance issues were immaterial or subject to remediation, and no material pending proceeding was identified.

The Group is an established Chinese cosmetics company manufacturing and selling skin care, maternity and childcare and toiletries products, with substantial revenue throughout the Track Record Period. Its core brands and products are commercialized and revenue-generating; new brands in the pipeline are supplementary rather than a precommercial core product.
